title: A barrier inside a branch
summary: What happens when only some threads of a block reach __syncthreads().

choices.text: Nothing: threads 64 to 127 skip the barrier, and the barrier only waits for the threads that reach it.
It deadlocks every time, because the barrier counts 128 threads and only 64 arrive, so the program always hangs.
The only bug is the out-of-range index `127 - threadIdx.x`, which reads past the end of the tile.
The barrier is in divergent code, which is undefined behavior: it may hang or appear to work, and the later read can see unwritten values.
